newsitem.title: USA: Salton/Maxim Q2 gross profit rises.
newsitem.headline: Salton/Maxim Q2 gross profit rises.

text.p: Salton/Maxim Housewares Inc said Tuesday its gross profit in the second quarter ended December 28 rose to 30.6 percent from 25.7 percent in the year-ago quarter.
The increase was due primarily to a higher margin sales mix, the housewares company said.

Earlier Tuesday, the company reported net income of $4 million, or $0.30 a share on 13.3 million shares, compared to net income of $2.4 million, or $0.36 a share on 6.6 million shares, in the prior year period.

"We anticipate continued strong financial growth in the coming quarters, particularly in light of the agreement we reached with Kmart to supply Kmart with a broad range of products under the White-Westinghouse brand name," chief executive officer Leonhard Dreimann said in a news release.
Salton/Maxim shares were up 1/16 at 8-1/16 Tuesday.
